title: Cascade Ortho Rider Certificate — Coinsurance of the Practices Rendering Covered Treatment
content:
**Orthodontic Benefit Riders: coinsurance for a takeover entry that supersedes a new-start entry.** For the member's repayment, the takeover benefit of a takeover entry that supersedes a new-start entry of the same case is valued at the coinsurance of the networks of the practices that render the covered treatment. This applies on a rider whose in-network and out-of-network coinsurance differ.

## Moved to the other network

This applies when the case moved to a practice of the network other than the new-start entry's, the move being both:

- in or after the month the case's coverage began; and
- no later than the takeover entry's date.

Then:

- the covered months before the month of the latest move take the coinsurance for the network on the new-start entry, however many moves came before;
- the rest take the coinsurance for the network on the latest transfer entry;
- the two are weighted by their months over the months remaining on the takeover entry.

## Not moved by the takeover date, network changed

This applies when the case had not moved by the takeover entry's date (it has no transfer entry, or its latest transfer entry is dated after the takeover entry), and the takeover entry's network differs from the new-start entry's because the practice joined or left Cascade's network after the banding date. Then the coinsurance for the network on the new-start entry applies, a case in progress keeping the terms it began under.

## Every other case

In every other case, including a rider whose two rates are the same, this rule does not apply.

## Riders on which the rates differ

| Rider | In network | Out of network |
|---|---|---|
| Cascade Ortho Rider Child 1000 | 50 | 40 |
| Cascade Ortho Rider Family 1500 | 50 | 40 |
| Cascade Ortho Rider Family 3000 | 60 | 50 |
| Cascade Ortho Rider Child 1500, Child 2000, Family 2000 | 50 | 50 (the rates are the same) |

## Hypothetical case

The case:

- on a rider paying 50 in network and 40 out of network;
- a superseding takeover entry with 18 months remaining;
- the new-start entry in network;
- the case moved to an out-of-network practice in the fourth covered month, before the takeover entry's date, so 3 covered months fall before the month of the move.

The coinsurance is 3 months at 50 and 15 months at 40, weighted over 18: that is 750 divided by 18, about 41.67 percent.

If the case had not moved by the takeover date, but the takeover entry shows out of network because the practice left the network after banding, the new-start entry's 50 percent applies.
